methods.stack(int index): public static net.minecraft.item.ItemStack; defensive copy, EMPTY if not ready or index outside0..5
methods.selectedSlot(): public static int; local presentation index0..5 when ready, -1 otherwise
methods.select(int index): public static void; local presentation selection only, valid0..5; no equip, mutation or server gameplay action
methods.requestEquip(int index): public static boolean; true means a valid request was queued, never server success
methods.requestOpen(): public static boolean; true means a request for a genuine server-owned Container was queued, never locally fabricated GUI data

ready_guarantee: A genuine received server snapshot matches the current connection, local player UUID, world identity/dimension, server-issued connection/dimension nonce, and has age<=100 local client ticks. Alive nonspectator player; unsupported future storage versions fail closed. Snapshots refresh at most20 server ticks while connected; clear on disconnect, world/connection/player replacement or dimension change.
selected_slot_semantics: Local selection is not a server acknowledgement. Only requestEquip asks the server to atomically swap a stored weapon with native mainhand. No fabricated preview stacks.
hud_scope: HUD renders exactly six actual stack copies and native count/glint/durability, uses wheel->select, existing use/R->requestEquip, button18->requestOpen; legacy shortcut/editor fallback only when module absent.
request_authority: Authenticated sender only; payload opcode/index plus server nonce/revision for freshness, no client stack/count/owner/target. Server revalidates alive/spectator, owner identity, world/session, active container, cursor, current ownership and available normal space.
storage_semantics: Six physical persistent server slots outside normal36. Equip moves stored weapon to native mainhand and swaps old weapon back. Nonweapon old hand goes to a free normal slot or operation rejects unchanged; no drops/clones.
